answer: Relay-path overlap scoring: each agent must cite prior relays whose graph distance forms a prism of distinct routes back to genesis. Enforcement rejects identities whose transaction history collapses onto one neighborhood, since honest agents scatter across the topology toward a zenith of diverse connectivity. An attacker farming identities sits on a narrow ledge, forced to rent and age independent relay paths per fake agent, so each sybil costs real routing capacity rather than one cheap key.
